dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Of note? Uh... Sure, I guess the clouds over there are perfect for staring at while you daydream. After all, in a noisy place like this, it's nice to just stand around and chill, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: If I could just apply this discovery to a new device...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hmm? Yeah, sure, take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hmm... What do you need? As long as you've got the blueprints, I can make you anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33>I'd like something made...</color>

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Sure, and by the way, I'm done with your previous commission. Need anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing at the moment?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Huh? Well, oh, nothing. Just wondering about some new uses for kuuvahki. Like, if we could upgrade this forging machine with it...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Of course, there aren't many craftpeople in Nod-Krai that can hope to stand up to "it" these days... Except for Aino, of course... Yeah, just Aino...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'll leave you to it then. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Yeah... See you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a blacksmith?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: A blacksmith? Do you think I count? I don't think I do... Compared to my old man, I can't even swing a hammer.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: I'm a researcher. A re-sear-cher. Even though... well, my research funds primarily come from smithy-work.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this machine...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hehe, pretty impressive, isn't it? This is mine and Aino's pride and joy: the Rossum Workshop's multipurpose forging device!

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Just toss in the right materials, and whether it be tools or weapons, this nifty device can pump out your product according to its standard manufacturing templates.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: I've heard from Miss Nefer that the northerners have something similar... though I'm not sure how they power their stuff without kuuvahki.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about kuuvahki...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Kuuvahki is like... Gah, it's hard to explain, so just think of it as a sort of powerful energy. That's how all the machines here are powered.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: The Frostmoon Scions call this a blessing or whatever... Just listen and nod when they do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like to buy some weapons.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hmm? Yeah, sure, take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Aino? Free today, are we? What brings you here to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Just happened to pass by while out shopping with Ineffa, so we're dropping by to play!

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: I see. And here I thought you were going to pose me another head-scratcher. You know I don't quite get your designs...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Oh, and by the way, the equipment you helped me modify the other time was pretty useful. Thanks a bunch.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: See? The processed ore is very pure, and the utilization rate is very high as well.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Of course! Who do you think's personally putting in the work tuning your stuff up, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, Whiz-Kid Aino, it's you. Oh, yes. I just went to buy some snacks. Want some? Y'know, before Ineffa gets here.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Bribes, huh? Okay. What do you want help with this time? Just so we're clear, I don't do boring projects. And if it's strong hands you need, go find Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Oh, come now. I just said I was thanking you for your help previously...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That's what you said last time, too — in fact, that's what you say every time. Pretty sure you're sure there's always gonna be a "next time," hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Ahem, uh, let's not talk about that. Come on, here's the candy. There's chocolate and krumkakes too, if that's more your speed.
